Economy · India

Stock Markets Fall Amid Rising Oil Prices and US-Iran Tensions

Indian stock markets experienced a significant downturn, with the Sensex and Nifty indices tumbling over 2%. This decline is attributed to escalating tensions between the U.S. and Iran, which have caused a sharp surge in crude oil prices. The rise in oil prices has also led to a slump in the stocks of oil marketing companies and aviation firms.
